---
title: "Embryo RNA variance partitioning"
author: "Leonard C. Steg"
date: '2026-09-02'
output: html_document
---

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(variancePartition)
  library(BiocParallel)
  library(limma)
  library(ggplot2)
})
```

Load results from DEA (mother as covariate) for the total, paternal and maternal transcriptomes
```{r}
se_paths <- c(
  dedup    = "Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/03_dea/TwoCell-Basemodel_dedup_mother/SE.rds",
  paternal = "Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/03_dea/TwoCell-Basemodel_pat_mother/SE.rds",
  maternal = "Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/03_dea/TwoCell-Basemodel_mat_mother/SE.rds"
)

output <- "Steg2026/EmbryoRNA/results/05_variance_partition/"

if (!file.exists(output)){
  dir.create(output, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

Define model and cutoffs
```{r}
register(SnowParam(4))

# Variance explained by father and mother (oocyte donor)
form <- ~ (1|Father) + (1|Mother)

# FDR cutoff for DEGs
fdr_cut <- 0.05

# Genes with more than 5% of variance explained by father
father_cut <- 0.05
```

Function for variance partitioning and enrichment of DEGs among genes with variance explained by father
```{r}
run_varpart <- function(name, assay_name = "logcpm") {

  se <- readRDS(se_paths[[name]])

  meta <- as.data.frame(colData(se))
  meta$Father <- factor(meta$Father)
  meta$Mother <- factor(meta$Mother)

  # Remove the diet group effect, so that father variance is estimated within groups
  expr <- removeBatchEffect(assay(se, assay_name), batch = meta$Group)

  # Variance partitioning
  vp <- fitExtractVarPartModel(expr, form, meta)
  saveRDS(vp, file = paste0(output, name, "_varpart.rds"))

  plot.vp <- plotVarPart(sortCols(vp)) +
    ggtitle(paste(name, "- within group"))

  ggsave(paste0(name, "_varpart.pdf"), plot = plot.vp, path = output, width = 5, height = 5)

  # Classify genes tested in the DEA as DEG and as having variance explained by father
  padj <- rowData(se)$dea$padj
  names(padj) <- rownames(se)

  df <- data.frame(gene = rownames(vp), Father = vp$Father, padj = padj[rownames(vp)])
  df <- df[!is.na(df$padj), ]
  df$DEG <- df$padj < fdr_cut
  df$high_father <- df$Father > father_cut

  # Cumulative distribution of father variance for DEGs and non-DEGs
  plot.ecdf <- ggplot(df, aes(Father, color = DEG)) +
    stat_ecdf() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = father_cut, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = name, x = "Father variance fraction (within group)", y = "Cumulative fraction of genes") +
    theme_minimal()

  ggsave(paste0(name, "_DEG_father_ecdf.pdf"), plot = plot.ecdf, path = output, width = 5, height = 4)

  # Fisher's exact test for enrichment of DEGs among genes with variance explained by father
  tab <- table(factor(df$DEG, c(FALSE, TRUE)), factor(df$high_father, c(FALSE, TRUE)))
  ft <- fisher.test(tab)

  write.csv(df[df$DEG & df$high_father, ], file = paste0(output, name, "_DEGs_highFather.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  # Summary
  data.frame(
    dataset = name,
    median_Father = median(vp$Father),
    median_Mother = median(vp$Mother),
    n_tested = nrow(df),
    n_DEG = sum(df$DEG),
    n_highFather = sum(df$high_father),
    n_DEG_highFather = sum(df$DEG & df$high_father),
    expected_overlap = round(sum(df$DEG) * sum(df$high_father) / nrow(df), 1),
    fisher_OR = unname(ft$estimate),
    OR_low = ft$conf.int[1],
    OR_high = ft$conf.int[2],
    fisher_p = ft$p.value
  )
}
```

Run for total, paternal and maternal transcriptomes and save summary
```{r}
res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(se_paths), run_varpart))

res

write.csv(res, file = paste0(output, "varpart_DEG_father_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
